about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Roasted Beetroot Hummus
recipes.summary: Earthy pink hummus with roasted beetroot and tahini, served with warm pita wedges.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C fan (220°C conventional). Wrap the beetroot in foil and roast for 40 minutes, until a knife slides in easily. Cool, then rub off the skins and chop.
Blend the beetroot, chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, olive oil, cumin and salt until smooth, adding the water a spoonful at a time until creamy.
Cut the pita into wedges and warm them in the oven for 5 minutes until crisp at the edges.
Spoon the hummus into a bowl, swirl with a little extra oil and serve with the pita.
notes: Snack. Vegan. Per serving: about 1/4 cup hummus and 1/3 of a pita. Keeps 4 days in the fridge. Wear gloves to avoid pink hands.

recipes.title: Spicy Harissa Hummus
recipes.summary: Creamy hummus lifted with harissa, served with crisp raw vegetable dippers.
steps: Blend the chickpeas, tahini, harissa, lemon juice, garlic, oil and salt until thick and smooth.
With the motor running, add the water a spoonful at a time until the hummus is silky.
Taste and add more lemon or salt if needed, then spoon into a bowl.
Serve with the carrot and cucumber sticks and a drizzle of oil.
notes: Snack. Vegan. Per serving: about 1/4 cup hummus with vegetable sticks. Keeps 4 days in the fridge. Harissa brands vary in heat, so start with 1 tbsp if unsure.

recipes.title: Edamame Hummus
recipes.summary: A bright green, high-protein dip made with edamame, tahini and lime.
steps: Boil the edamame for 4 minutes until tender, then drain and cool under cold running water.
Blend the edamame with the tahini, lime juice, garlic, oil, cumin and salt until chunky-smooth.
Add the water a spoonful at a time until creamy, then spoon into a bowl.
Serve with the capsicum strips and cucumber sticks.
notes: Snack. Vegan. Per serving: about 1/4 cup dip with vegetables. Keeps 3 days in the fridge; the colour dulls but the flavour holds.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Hummus
recipes.summary: Mellow roasted sweet potato blended into hummus with smoked paprika, served with pita chips.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C fan (220°C conventional). Toss the sweet potato with 1 tbsp of the oil and roast for 30 minutes, until soft and lightly browned.
Cut the pita into triangles and bake alongside for the last 6 minutes until crisp.
Blend the sweet potato with the chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, remaining oil, paprika and salt until smooth, adding 2 to 3 tbsp water if thick.
Serve the hummus topped with a pinch of paprika and the pita chips.
notes: Snack. Vegan. Per serving: about 1/4 cup hummus with 1/3 of a pita. Keeps 4 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Roasted Red Pepper Hummus
recipes.summary: Sweet roasted capsicum hummus with garlic and lemon, served with toasted pita wedges.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C fan (240°C conventional). Roast the whole capsicums for 25 minutes, turning once, until the skins blister and blacken.
Cover the capsicums in a bowl for 10 minutes, then peel, deseed and roughly chop.
Blend the capsicum with the chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, oil, salt and paprika until smooth.
Cut the pita into wedges and toast under the grill until crisp, then serve with the hummus, drizzled with oil.
notes: Snack. Vegan. Per serving: about 1/4 cup hummus and 1/3 of a pita. Keeps 4 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Mutabal Tahini Eggplant Dip
recipes.summary: Smoky roasted eggplant blended with tahini and Greek yoghurt, creamier than baba ganoush.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C fan (240°C conventional). Prick the eggplants, set on a tray and roast for 40 minutes, turning once, until collapsed and charred.
Split the eggplants and scoop the soft flesh into a sieve to drain for 5 minutes, discarding the skins.
Mash the flesh with the tahini, yoghurt, lemon juice, crushed garlic and salt until creamy but still textured.
Spoon into a bowl, drizzle with the oil, scatter with parsley and serve with warm pita wedges.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: about 1/3 cup dip with 1/3 of a pita. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Muhammara Walnut Dip
recipes.summary: Syrian roasted red capsicum and walnut dip with a sweet-tart finish, thick enough to scoop.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C fan (240°C conventional). Roast the capsicums for 25 minutes, turning once, until blackened in patches. Cover for 10 minutes, then peel and deseed.
Toast the walnuts in a dry pan for 4 minutes until fragrant, then cool.
Blitz the capsicum, walnuts, breadcrumbs, lemon juice, honey, garlic, cumin, chilli and salt to a thick, slightly coarse paste, then stream in the oil.
Spoon into a bowl and serve with toasted pita wedges.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian (honey). Contains tree nuts and gluten. Per serving: about 3 tbsp dip and 1/4 of a pita. Keeps 5 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Avocado Salsa Verde Dip
recipes.summary: Creamy avocado blended with a cooked green tomato salsa, served with baked tortilla chips.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C fan (220°C conventional). Cut the tortillas into wedges, toss with the oil and a pinch of salt, and bake for 8 minutes until crisp.
Simmer the green tomatoes and jalapeno in a small pan with 1/4 cup water for 5 minutes until soft, then cool slightly.
Blend the cooked tomato mixture with the coriander, lime juice, onion and salt, then add the avocado and pulse until creamy.
Serve straight away with the warm chips.
notes: Snack. Vegan. Per serving: about 1/3 cup dip with 4 chips. Best eaten within 2 hours; press cling film onto the surface to stop browning.

recipes.title: Pea Guacamole
recipes.summary: A thrifty, vivid guacamole stretched with peas, with lime, coriander and chilli.
steps: Cover the peas with boiling water for 3 minutes, then drain and cool under cold water.
Blitz the peas to a rough paste, then mash in the avocado, lime juice, onion, coriander, chilli, cumin and salt until creamy but still chunky.
Toast the tortillas in a dry pan for 1 minute each side, cut into wedges and crisp for a further 2 minutes.
Serve the guacamole with the tortilla wedges.
notes: Snack. Vegan. Per serving: about 1/3 cup guacamole with 2/3 of a tortilla. Eat within a day; press cling film onto the surface.

recipes.title: Mango Guacamole
recipes.summary: Chunky guacamole with ripe mango, lime and a little heat, great with corn chips.
steps: Mash the avocados with a fork until creamy but still chunky.
Fold in the mango, onion, chilli, lime juice, coriander and salt.
Taste and add more lime or salt, then spoon into a bowl.
Serve straight away with the corn chips.
notes: Snack. Vegan. Per serving: about 1/3 cup guacamole with 13g of chips. Best eaten the same day.

recipes.title: Cucumber Raita
recipes.summary: Cooling yoghurt with cucumber, mint and roasted cumin, a classic partner for spiced snacks.
steps: Toast the cumin seeds in a dry pan for 1 minute until fragrant, then crush lightly.
Squeeze the grated cucumber in your hands to remove excess water.
Stir the cucumber, mint, salt and cumin through the yoghurt.
Spoon into a bowl, dust with the chilli powder and serve with chapati wedges.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: about 1/3 cup raita with 2/3 of a chapati. Keeps 2 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Beetroot Raita
recipes.summary: Magenta yoghurt dip with grated cooked beetroot, curry leaves and mustard seeds.
steps: Simmer the beetroot in a small pan with 1/4 cup water for 15 minutes, until tender and the water has gone. Cool.
Heat the oil, add the mustard seeds and cook for 30 seconds until they pop, then stir in the curry powder.
Stir the beetroot, salt and the tempered spices through the yoghurt.
Serve with warm chapati wedges.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: about 1/3 cup raita with 2/3 of a chapati. Keeps 2 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Mint and Coriander Yoghurt Dip
recipes.summary: Fresh green chutney folded through yoghurt for kebabs, pakoras and crisps.
steps: Blend the mint, coriander, chilli, lemon juice, sugar, cumin and salt with 2 tbsp water to a smooth green paste.
Fold the paste through the yoghurt until evenly green.
Taste and adjust the salt and lemon, then spoon into a bowl.
Serve with the carrot sticks.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: about 3 tbsp dip with vegetables. Keeps 2 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Beetroot Tzatziki
recipes.summary: Pink-purple tzatziki with grated raw beetroot, garlic and dill, served with warm pita.

items: 1 small raw beetroot (100g), peeled and grated

steps: Squeeze the grated cucumber in your hands to remove excess water.
Stir the cucumber, beetroot, garlic, oil, lemon juice, dill and salt through the yoghurt until evenly pink.
Warm the pita in a dry pan for 1 minute each side and cut into wedges.
Serve the tzatziki with the warm pita.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: about 1/3 cup tzatziki with 1/3 of a pita. Keeps 2 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Rosemary Cannellini Dip with Sourdough Fingers
recipes.summary: A smooth cannellini dip with roasted garlic flavour, rosemary and lemon, served with toasted sourdough.

items: 400g can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Warm the garlic and rosemary in 1 tbsp of the oil in a small pan for 3 minutes, without letting the garlic brown.
Blend the beans, the warm garlic oil, lemon juice, salt and 3 tbsp water until completely smooth.
Toast the sourdough until golden, cut each slice into 4 fingers and arrange around a bowl.
Spoon in the dip and finish with the remaining oil.
notes: Snack. Vegan. Per serving: about 1/4 cup dip with 2/3 of a slice of toast. Keeps 4 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Caprese Skewers
recipes.summary: Cherry tomato, basil and bocconcini on skewers with a balsamic drizzle for easy entertaining.
steps: Thread a tomato, a basil leaf and a bocconcini onto each of 24 short skewers or toothpicks.
Arrange the skewers on a platter.
Whisk the oil, balsamic, salt and pepper until combined and drizzle over the skewers just before serving.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian (fresh mozzarella uses non-animal rennet in most brands; check the label). Per serving: 4 skewers. Best eaten within 2 hours; keep chilled until serving.

recipes.title: Prawn and Chorizo Skewers
recipes.summary: Garlicky prawns and chorizo threaded and grilled, a quick tapas-style party bite.

items: 18 large raw prawns (about 400g), peeled and deveined

steps: Toss the prawns with the oil, garlic, paprika, lemon juice and salt. Thread each skewer with 3 prawns, alternating with 3 pieces of chorizo.
Heat a grill or griddle pan to high and cook the skewers for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until the prawns are pink and opaque and the chorizo is sizzling.
Scatter with the parsley and serve hot with lemon wedges.
notes: Snack. Per serving: 1 skewer of 3 prawns and 3 pieces of chorizo.
Food safety: keep raw prawns refrigerated until cooking, cook until opaque and pink throughout, wash hands and boards after handling raw seafood, and eat within 2 hours or refrigerate leftovers.

recipes.title: Soy-Mirin Chicken Thigh Skewers
recipes.summary: Glazed chicken thigh skewers with a sweet soy tare, cooked in the oven.

items: 500g chicken thigh fillets, cut into 3cm pieces

steps: Simmer the soy sauce, mirin, honey and ginger in a small pan for 4 minutes until slightly syrupy, then cool a little.
Thread the chicken and spring onion onto 12 skewers and brush with oil.
Heat the oven grill to high and grill the skewers on a lined tray for 12 minutes, turning and brushing with the glaze every 4 minutes, until the chicken reaches 75°C in the centre.
Brush with a final layer of glaze and serve hot.
notes: Snack. Per serving: 2 skewers.

Food safety: cook chicken to 75°C throughout, wash hands, boards and utensils after handling raw chicken, do not reuse the raw-chicken brush on cooked skewers, and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Mini Beef Sliders
recipes.summary: Juicy beef patties on mini buns with cheese, pickles and a quick sauce.
steps: Mix the mince with the salt and pepper and shape into 8 small patties slightly wider than the buns.

Heat the oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the patties for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until browned and cooked through with no pink inside. Lay half a cheese slice on each in the last minute.
Toast the buns cut side down in the pan for 1 minute.
Mix the tomato sauce and mayonnaise, spread on the buns, then add lettuce, patty and pickle.
notes: Snack. Per serving: 1 slider.
Food safety: cook beef mince to 75°C throughout until no pink remains, wash hands and surfaces after handling raw mince, and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Crispy Baked Chicken Sliders
recipes.summary: Oven-crisped crumbed chicken pieces on mini buns with slaw.

items: 500g chicken breast, sliced into 8 thin pieces

steps: Heat the oven to 210°C fan (230°C conventional). Mix the panko with the paprika, salt and oil.
Dip each chicken piece in the flour, the egg, then the panko mixture, pressing on firmly.
Bake on a lined tray for 20 minutes, turning once, until golden and the chicken reaches 75°C in the centre.
Toss the cabbage with 1 tbsp of the mayonnaise and the lemon juice. Spread the rest on the buns and fill with chicken and slaw.
notes: Snack. Per serving: 1 slider.
Food safety: cook chicken to 75°C throughout, wash hands and boards after handling raw chicken and egg, and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Mushroom Walnut Sliders
recipes.summary: A savoury mushroom and walnut patty on mini buns with mustard and rocket.
steps: Cook the mushrooms in a dry frying pan over medium-high heat for 8 minutes until the liquid has gone, then add 1 tbsp of the oil, the onion and the garlic and cook for 5 minutes more.
Stir in the soy sauce, mustard, walnuts and oats, then cool slightly and shape into 8 small patties.
Fry the patties in the remaining oil for 3 minutes per side until crisp and golden.
Fill the toasted buns with the patties and rocket.
notes: Snack. Vegan (check the bun label). Contains tree nuts, gluten and soy. Per serving: 1 slider. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Spinach and Ricotta Stuffed Mushrooms
recipes.summary: Button mushrooms filled with spinach, ricotta and lemon, baked until golden.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C fan (220°C conventional). Twist the stalks out of the mushrooms and finely chop 4 of them.
Cook the chopped stalks and garlic in the oil for 2 minutes, add the spinach and cook for 2 minutes more until wilted, then squeeze dry and chop.
Mix with the ricotta, lemon zest, salt and pepper and fill the mushroom caps, then top with the breadcrumbs.
Bake for 20 minutes until the filling is golden and the mushrooms are tender.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 3 stuffed mushrooms. Best served warm. Keeps 2 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Pork and Thyme Mushroom Caps
recipes.summary: Large mushrooms stuffed with seasoned pork sausage meat and herbs, baked until sizzling.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C fan (220°C conventional). Remove the mushroom stalks and finely chop 3 of them.
Fry the onion, garlic and chopped stalks in the oil for 5 minutes until soft, then cool and mix with the sausage meat, breadcrumbs, thyme and pepper.
Fill the caps with the mixture, pressing firmly, and place on a lined tray.
Bake for 22 minutes, until the filling is browned and cooked through at 75°C.
notes: Snack. Per serving: 2 stuffed mushrooms.
Food safety: pork sausage meat must reach 75°C throughout with no pink remaining, wash hands and surfaces after handling raw pork, and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon Cucumber Rounds
recipes.summary: Thick cucumber rounds topped with dill cream cheese and smoked salmon, ready in minutes.

items: 2 Lebanese cucumbers, cut into 12 thick rounds

steps: Mix the cream cheese with the lemon juice, half the dill and the pepper until smooth.
Pipe or spoon a small mound onto each cucumber round.
Fold a piece of smoked salmon on top of each, then finish with the remaining dill and a caper.
notes: Snack. Per serving: 3 rounds.
Food safety: smoked salmon is a ready-to-eat chilled food. Keep refrigerated, eat within 2 hours of serving, and pregnant women and people with weakened immunity should avoid it.

recipes.title: Classic Devilled Eggs
recipes.summary: Creamy mustard-and-paprika egg yolk filling piped into halved boiled eggs.
steps: Cover the eggs with cold water, bring to the boil, then simmer for 10 minutes. Cool in iced water, then peel.
Halve the eggs lengthways and pop the yolks into a bowl.
Mash the yolks with the mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar and salt until smooth, then spoon or pipe into the whites.
Dust with paprika and scatter with chives.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 2 egg halves.
Food safety: cook the eggs until the yolks are firm, keep chilled until serving, eat within 2 hours at room temperature and refrigerate leftovers for up to 2 days.
